lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity white spots is distributed across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits, with clusters of approximately 10-15 pixels in diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear features of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs to form a visible lattice-like coordinate system across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from higher luminance on the upper surface to a shadow gradient immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette exhibits a sparse distribution of low-intensity white spots, primarily clustered within the lower-anterior and central regions of the fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and trailing beneath the pectoral fin area.
